title: Hi, my name is Martha: Using names to measure and mitigate bias in generative dialogue models

bias_targets.methodology: Generating dialogue model self-chats seeded with name templates or explicitly gendered nouns associated with men or women, and measuring bias using overindexed word/occupation frequencies, token distribution differences, and a pre-trained multi-dimensional gender bias classifier.

Generating dialogue model self-chats seeded with names statistically associated with specific races or ethnicities (AAPI, Black, Hispanic, White) and analyzing the frequency of specific stereotypical or microaggressive phrases in the conversational partner's responses.
